items.title: Create package skeleton
acceptance_criteria: Repository contains DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, and R/ directory.
At least one exported function is available from NAMESPACE.
Tests entrypoint exists at tests/testthat.R.

items.title: Matrix orientation and projection utilities
acceptance_criteria: Input matrix is converted to internal N x T orientation.
Output is restored to original orientation.
Projection helper removes nuisance subspace using QR.

items.title: Differenced-energy voxel scoring
acceptance_criteria: Function computes mean(diff(x)^2) per voxel in O(N*T).
Sorted-score linear baseline and delta are returned.
Function errors for fewer than 3 time points.

items.title: wNN thresholding modes
acceptance_criteria: Percentile mode supports nt_q and nn_q and produces piecewise-linear ramp.
Mixture mode produces soft posterior-based wNN in [0,1].
Returned output includes wNN, delta, and threshold diagnostics.

items.title: Low-rank decomposition with randomized SVD option
acceptance_criteria: truncated_svd supports svd_engine values auto, rsvd, svd.
When svd_engine='rsvd', rsvd::rsvd is used.
When svd_engine='auto', rsvd::rsvd is used for rank-truncated decompositions.
Function returns u, d, v and engine metadata.

items.title: One-shot CAA extractor
acceptance_criteria: extract_caa_oneshot takes K x T and returns T x L scores.
Lagged cross-covariance SVD is used to derive candidates.
Predictability vector is returned from singular values.

items.title: Optional DiCCA/DiPCA wrappers
acceptance_criteria: extract_dynamic_components supports extractor=dicca and extractor=dipca.
Code fails fast with a clear message when dipca is unavailable.
Scores and predictability are normalized to common output fields.

items.title: Vectorized NN/NT ratio scoring
acceptance_criteria: Per-component R2 maps are computed via matrix-vector products.
RatioNN_NT is computed as median(R2_NN)/median(R2_NT).
Code errors clearly if NN or NT voxel sets are empty.

items.title: Design guardrail
acceptance_criteria: When design is supplied, candidate components are orthogonalized to design.
Design row count must match time points.
Near-zero post-orthogonalization components are dropped.

items.title: Split-half stability filter
acceptance_criteria: Half-split extraction is recomputed on each split.
Components pass only if both halves show correlation above threshold.
Filter can be disabled with stability=none.

items.title: One-shot nuisance projection
acceptance_criteria: Selected nuisance matrix is projected out using QR.
No per-voxel regression loop is required.
Output shape matches original input orientation.

items.title: Rcpp kernels for scoring and stability
acceptance_criteria: score_components_nn_nt_cpp is implemented in src/rcpp_kernels.cpp using RcppArmadillo.
stability_filter_cpp is implemented in src/rcpp_kernels.cpp using RcppArmadillo.
R functions auto-dispatch to C++ kernels when package symbols are loaded and fallback to pure R otherwise.

items.title: CompCor reduction pathway
acceptance_criteria: compcor_denoise supports mode='acompcorr' with nuisance_mask or wNN-based ROI selection.
compcor_denoise supports mode='tcompcorr' using top temporal-variance voxel selection.
CompCor regressors are extracted via low-rank decomposition and projected out in one shot.
Optional pre-PCA DCT high-pass is available via pre_highpass='dct'.

items.title: Smoke tests
acceptance_criteria: At least three tests exist covering wNN, end-to-end run, and orientation handling.
Tests execute without requiring dipca or neuroim2.
Tests validate dimensional consistency and bounded weights.

items.title: Benchmark harness
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic benchmark script reports walltime per step.
Benchmark compares svd_engine=svd vs svd_engine=rsvd on large N,T.
Results are stored in a machine-readable artifact.

items.title: Design-free QC report
acceptance_criteria: QC computes NT tSNR delta and NN variance reduction.
QC reports component counts and ratio distributions.
QC output is serializable for CI pipelines.

notes: rsvd is a required randomized SVD backend.
dipca is optional and only needed for extractor=dicca or extractor=dipca.
neuroim2 integration is matrix-first in this revision and can be expanded with dedicated S4 methods.
